mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.1% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as capital shifts from bonds to equities.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.0% triggers central bank rate cuts to stimulate demand, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as monetary easing accelerates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as recession fears dominate market sentiment.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth rate below 0.5% monthly signals manufacturing weakness, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as recession risks increase.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth rate is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth above 0.5% monthly consistently indicates robust economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 0.5% monthly.

mechanism_narrative: Annualized inflation exceeding 2.5% signals central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days as higher discount rates reduce equity valuations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts and GDP growth rate below 1.0% annualized indicate broad economic contraction, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and GDPC1 fails to generate negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales growth rate exceeding 1.0% monthly signals strong consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as earnings growth expectations rise.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS growth rate exceeds 1.0%.
